review_candidates.title: Asian Business Sales Manager | Mandarin Speaker | Auckland
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity Auckland’s construction and property development market is diverse, relationship-driven and commercially significant. To better serve this market and capture its full potential, we have created a new leadership role within our Trade structure. This is not a role where you inherit a finished plan. It is an opportunity to help shape the strategy, strengthen our market presence, build enduring customer and supplier relationships, and lead a team focused on sustainable, profitable growth. Reporting to the General Manager Trade Sales, you will take ownership of the sales performance, supply requirements and growth of Riviera’s trade business within Auckland’s Mandarin-speaking construction market. Working across the Riviera Hardware Holdings Group, you will lead Trade Account Managers, develop customer opportunities, and work closely with operational, inventory and supplier teams to ensure our growth plans can be delivered. You will be expected to understand the market, identify where the opportunities are, and turn those opportunities into measurable sales, margin and customer growth. Professional fluency in Mandarin is essential because you will work directly with Mandarin-speaking customers and commercial decision-makers. Cantonese language skills would be highly regarded. What You’ll Be Responsible For You will lead the commercial development and performance of this key trade portfolio, including: developing and implementing a clear market and sales strategy to grow our presence and market share identifying new business opportunities and building trusted relationships across the construction and property development sector leading and coaching Trade Account Managers, setting clear sales and margin targets and holding the team accountable for delivery developing account plans that grow sales beyond core building products and increase the value of each customer account monitoring sales pipelines, customer activity, market movement and competitor activity working with Trade Operations, branch teams and suppliers to align stock availability and service capability with planned growth maintaining disciplined controls across margin, pricing and customer credit, supported by clear reporting on sales and portfolio performance What You’ll Bring This role requires an experienced commercial sales leader who understands that meaningful growth comes from strong relationships, disciplined execution and consistent follow-through. You will bring: professional fluency in spoken and written Mandarin strong written and verbal communication skills in English the ability to communicate in Cantonese would be an advantage an in-depth understanding of the New Zealand construction and property development market, including established knowledge of Auckland’s construction and building supplies sector a record of growing sales and profitability, supported by strong commercial judgement and confidence working with sales, margin and pipeline data experience leading, coaching and holding salespeople accountable for results a practical and disciplined approach to planning, stock and supply requirements, pricing, credit, risk and commercial controls Why This Role Stands Out This Is a Rare Opportunity To Step Into a Newly Created Position With Genuine Scope To Influence How The Business Approaches And Grows An Important Market. You Will Have ownership of a commercially significant growth portfolio the opportunity to shape the market strategy rather than simply maintain an existing model direct access to experienced senior trade and commercial leaders the backing of one of the largest groups in the Mitre 10 network the scale, product range and operational support needed to turn opportunity into results the chance to build team capability and create a strong platform for future growth career opportunities across the wider Riviera Hardware Holdings Group access to staff purchasing benefits across selected Mitre 10 stores discounts at selected Columbus Coffee cafés access to a range of retail, travel and lifestyle savings About Us Riviera Hardware Holdings Ltd is the largest group within the Mitre 10 network and is proudly Kiwi-owned and operated. Our business includes Mitre 10 MEGA stores in Albany, New Lynn, Silverdale and Warkworth, Mitre 10 Whangaparaoa, a Distribution Centre, a Frame & Truss Manufacturing Plant, and several Columbus Coffee cafés. This diverse portfolio gives us the scale, operational capability and local market presence to support customers across retail, trade, distribution, manufacturing and hospitality sectors. Trade is a core part of our business. Through the strength of the Mitre 10 Trade network, dedicated Trade teams, commercial account solutions and broad product offering, we support everyone from sole-trader builders and trade contractors through to developers and commercial customers across Auckland. This role offers the opportunity to represent a trusted Kiwi brand that continues to invest in supporting New Zealand's building and construction industry. What’s Next If you know this market, are fluent in Mandarin, understand how trusted commercial relationships are built, and have the leadership and discipline to turn opportunity into profitable growth, we want to hear from you. Apply online with your CV and cover letter and tell us how you have made an impact in this market, the customers and sales teams you have helped grow, and how you would strengthen our presence across Auckland’s construction sector.

review_candidates.title: Technical Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: Candidates must be comfortable working standard business hours aligned with the Pacific Time Zone. Overview We are looking for a Technical Support Specialist to join our Customer Support team. This role will report to the Manager of Customer Support and will have an immediate and lasting impact on our business by supporting core customers and products. In this role, you will be given agency in your day to day work and your voice will be heard across internal teams. Nuanced investigations, continual product advancement, and customer interactions mean each day is unique; there aren’t any repetitive tasks to be found here. As our team reaches goals we work together to set new ones to ensure we continually improve as a team. This is a Pacific Time Zone based role. As a member of the Customer Support function, you will: Technical Support: Establish a deep understanding of technical and payment domains that are required to understand the fundamentals of money movement, while being a subject matter expert in our core products, including the nuanced dependencies and gaps between each of them. Use this knowledge, along with technical skills (in APIs, SQL, RegEx, SFTP, and JSON protocol) in order to investigate, triage, and troubleshoot issues reported by internal and external customers during business hours within our stated SLAs. Incident Management: Participate in a 24/7 response team and respond to incidents and high-priority requests from customers with premium support coverage. This workstream may involve time sensitive and high priority requests after normal business hours. At Modern Treasury Customer Support is deeply involved throughout the identification, response, and retrospective stages of an incident, working closely with EPD teams to identify root causes and drive product changes that prevent issues from recurring. Reconciliation Operations: Leverage deep knowledge of Modern Treasury’s object structures, data architecture, and fundamentals of reconciliation in order to investigate changes or new patterns in bank integration reporting, manually reconcile objects, improve reconciliation logic using rubular, and give feedback to Engineering, Product, and Bank Operations teams in order to address upstream data (ingestion and normalization) and process problems. Project Management: Identify gaps and assist in planning, developing, and implementing policies, procedures, performance standards, and other projects to improve Customer Support operations and the way internal and external users work with Modern Treasury Process Improvement: Use data-driven methodologies to collate customer feedback and trends. Share customer- and product-specific recommendations with EPD and GTM in order to mitigate recurring issues or develop new capabilities that increase our customers’ operational efficiency. We strongly believe that investing in personal and professional growth puts us in a position to deliver long-term value to our customers. This role offers a unique opportunity for growth in a value-driven company, and it sits at the intersection of our customers, our people, and our products. What we’re looking for: 4+ years experience in customer facing roles at B2B SaaS companies in one or more of the following functions: technical support, customer success, sales engineering, product management, engineering, network operations. Knowledge of web connectivity and integration protocols such as JSON / XML, file transfer protocols such as FTP / FTPS / SFTP, API tools such as Postman, and API concepts such as idempotency and pagination. Experience in managing high quality projects, process improvement, and change management. Experience with business intelligence tools such as Looker, DataDog, and Sentry. We welcome candidates who don't meet every requirement above but demonstrate strong technical aptitude and a genuine passion for learning. About Modern Treasury Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins, plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting, Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale. WEEK BY WEEK During your first week you will: Complete our company onboarding process where you will learn all about Modern Treasury – our values, our history, our product, our brand – and meet various teams via small-group sessions alongside your onboarding peers. Get acquainted with our products with self-guided and hands-on training with an onboarding buddy. Develop an understanding of our customers, user personas, sales process, and customer stories. Read our favorite industry primers. During your first six weeks you will: Meet and build relationships with leaders and members of the Customer Success, Engineering, Product, Sales, and Marketing teams. Shadow CSMs, and other Technical Support Specialists, while responding to customers’ daily support inquiries as part of your technical onboarding. Through this, you will gain a deep understanding of our customers, their use cases, and the various stages of their journey with Modern Treasury. Become a technical expert in Modern Treasury’s product suite and partner closely with the Customer Success and Engineering teams to support our customers. This is an important step towards understanding our customers, the problems we solve for them, the processes we need to build, and the key decisions we need to make as we scale the Support team. Be shadowed as you begin to respond to inbound support inquiries. During your first six months you will: Support customers via email and Slack with a high degree of autonomy within our stated SLAs. Own customer requests through resolution, working cross-functionally - with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and other teams - as needed. Contribute to internal and external self-help documentation. Identify areas of opportunity and manage projects to refine processes and systems accordingly to improve the customer experience. Become a master in our application and API. Modern Treasury is committed to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate in any employment opportunities or practices based on an individual's race, color, creed, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), religion (all aspects of religious beliefs, observance or practice, including religious dress or grooming practices), marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry (including language use restrictions and possession of a driver’s license issued under California Vehicle Code section 12801.9), natural hair, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, medical condition (including cancer or a record or history of cancer, and genetic characteristics), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition), genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits unlawful discrimination based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. Modern Treasury participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Compensation Range: $95K - $130K

review_candidates.description: Description Leidos is seeking highly qualified professionals to support the TSA FOCUS Program . We are especially interested in connecting with current incumbent personnel supporting this mission who are interested in continuing their work and bringing their valuable mission knowledge and experience to Leidos. Position Summary The Onsite & Remote Desktop Support role provides end-user computing and site support services across TSA locations and remotely. The position performs troubleshooting, installation, configuration, replacement, validation, and maintenance of supported end-user and site equipment while coordinating activities through approved service management processes. The position may provide onsite, remote, dispatchable, surge, project, IMAC, and other technical support based on operational requirements. Essential Duties Provide onsite and remote technical support for end-user computing and supported site equipment. Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, peripheral, and endpoint issues. Perform installation, configuration, replacement, and operational validation of supported equipment. Support hardware/software installs, moves, adds, changes, and decommissioning activities. Respond to dispatched technical support requirements at assigned TSA locations. Coordinate site access, scheduling, logistics, travel, and customer communications. Maintain accurate ticket updates, technical documentation, and service records. Coordinate escalations with Service Desk, network, engineering, asset management, cybersecurity, vendors, and other support teams. Support regional surge, deployment, project, and IMAC activities as required. Perform break/fix activities within approved procedures and escalate system-level issues appropriately. Validate successful resolution and restoration of supported services. Maintain accurate technical and asset information associated with supported equipment. Support continuity of resident-site operations when providing remote or dispatchable services. Minimum Qualifications Requires BS degree and 2+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters with less than 2+ years of prior relevant experience. In lieu of degree, additional experience may be required. Ability to obtain and maintain TSA Suitability Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust security clearance Relevant experience supporting desktop, field, endpoint, or site support functions in an enterprise or federal IT environment. Strong troubleshooting, customer service, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently at customer locations and coordinate effectively with remote technical teams. Ability to work with approved service management procedures and systems. Preferred Qualifications TSA, DHS, or other federal IT experience. Experience supporting geographically distributed enterprise environments. Experience with IMAC activities and endpoint deployment. CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, or comparable technical certification is desirable. Work Requirements The position may require onsite support, travel, dispatch activities, and/or shift work depending on assigned TSA location and operational requirements. review_candidates.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go)
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go) based in Canada . This is a senior technical role focused on building and evolving database automation and PostgreSQL-as-a-service capabilities at internet scale. You will use Go to automate the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning. Your work will make database operations safer, more consistent, resilient, and easier to scale across high-throughput, always-on services. You will help replace bespoke database configurations with standardized platforms and repeatable automation. The role combines hands-on engineering, technical leadership, architecture, and close collaboration with infrastructure and product engineering teams. You will also operate the systems you build in production and use real-world feedback to continuously improve them. The environment is fully remote, asynchronous, and highly collaborative, with a strong emphasis on ownership, automation, and AI-enabled productivity. Accountabilities Design, build, test, review, and maintain Go-based automation covering the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning. Develop automation across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure while evaluating operator-based approaches for managing stateful services. Build reliable services and automation capable of supporting high-throughput, always-on production workloads where correctness, latency, and availability are critical. Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into a coherent PostgreSQL platform. Develop a standardized PostgreSQL-as-a-service platform that reduces bespoke database configurations and enables database operations to scale without requiring equivalent growth in the operations team. Build safe and repeatable PostgreSQL major-version upgrade automation and validate changes against real production traffic before deployment. Research and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, reliability, and data health while proactively addressing critical database saturation points. Use AI agents and productivity tools throughout implementation, code review, service operations, and repetitive engineering workflows while maintaining the repository context required for effective team collaboration. Collaborate with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, database, and platform engineering teams to design and deliver high-performing solutions. Provide technical direction for major initiatives, turning ambiguous problems into clear architectures and sequenced execution plans that enable multiple engineers to work in parallel. Review database automation and Go contributions with a focus on safety, maintainability, performance, and long-term operational reliability. Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and platform guidance that enable other engineers to effectively use and contribute to the systems. Operate the solutions you build in production end to end and use operational feedback to guide subsequent iterations and improvements. Influence engineering practices beyond the immediate team through design reviews, mentorship, cross-team collaboration, and reusable technical patterns. Requirements You bring professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating database-as-a-service capabilities. You have strong proficiency in Go, including experience designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services. You have experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or comparable automation for the lifecycle management of stateful services, particularly databases. You are comfortable with infrastructure as code and understand core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs. You have demonstrated ownership of the technical direction for significant initiatives and can translate ambiguous technical challenges into scalable architectures and executable plans. You have experience working with high-throughput, always-on production systems where reliability, performance, and operational safety are essential. Familiarity with Ruby is a plus, particularly for working within environments that use Ruby on Rails, but it is not required at the start of the role. You have strong written communication skills and are comfortable collaborating asynchronously within a distributed, all-remote team. You are self-directed, well organized, and capable of managing priorities independently while maintaining strong ownership of outcomes. You demonstrate strong alignment with principles of transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and open-source contribution. You can influence engineering practices beyond your immediate team and are comfortable partnering with database, infrastructure, and platform teams. You have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical growth through design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. Benefits The position is fully remote and supports an asynchronous, distributed working environment. The U.S. base salary range is $152,800–$259,200 USD, depending on level, experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, market data, equity considerations, and geographic location. The listed base salary does not include potential bonuses, equity compensation, or benefits. Benefits are designed to support employees’ health, finances, and overall well-being. Flexible paid time off is provided. Equity compensation and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan are available. A Growth and Development Fund supports ongoing professional learning and development. Parental leave is provided. Team Member Resource Groups support an inclusive and collaborative workplace. Employees have opportunities to work with modern AI tools and incorporate AI into their daily workflows to improve efficiency, innovation, and impact. Location-based eligibility requirements may apply depending on the employee’s country and role.
